plan: Copy-on-read everywhere: build the adapted recipe from fresh dicts/lists so neither adapt() nor print_original() ever mutates inputs, making exact original reprint trivial.
Scale first: multiply every quantity (top-level, component, and later additional ingredients) by target_yield / recipe yield using Fraction arithmetic only.

Resolve each ingredient with a chain-substitution loop: while its name is excluded, pick the catalog choice with lowest (priority, catalog index), apply quantity_factor/unit/preparation/wording/equipment/yield effects, and track a per-chain seen-set to detect reintroduction cycles.
Feed substitution-introduced additional ingredients into the same pending work queue so they are scaled, exclusion-checked, and substitutable like authored ingredients (chained adaptation).
Accumulate reasons in a set across all ingredients, components, and equipment checks so every independently applicable impossibility is reported; sort reasons and warnings before returning.
Apply explicit wording_changes to instruction strings (warning when the old text is absent), then rewrite any leftover occurrences of a replaced name so no excluded ingredient remains anywhere.
Check equipment availability after all substitution-driven adds/removals; emit one 'equipment NAME unavailable' reason per missing item and sort final equipment.
Drop optional components whose adaptation fails with a warning; merge reasons from required components.
Compensate accumulated yield_factor at the end so the adapted recipe sits exactly at target_yield; regenerate authored_text for the adapted recipe with a deterministic renderer.
mechanisms: Fraction-based pure scaling pass (target_yield / authored yield applied to every quantity)
Deterministic candidate ranking by (priority, catalog order) tuple sort
Chain-substitution resolver with per-chain seen-set cycle detection
Pending work queue subjecting additional ingredients to the same exclusion/substitution pipeline
Accumulating reason/warning sets (sorted on output) for multi-reason impossibility reporting
Two-stage instruction rewriting: explicit wording_changes, then residual name replacement
Optional-component omission with warning instead of failure
Yield-factor accumulation with final quantity compensation to hold the target yield
Copy-on-read construction guaranteeing input immutability and byte-exact print_original
